title: riskell-ext snap --list --json
description: The picture set: what `risk snap` draws, what scripts/make-screenshots composes from those, and what the script's own maker list and this table disagree about. Contracted: every row has an id, whether this command draws it or the script composes it, whether making it starts a scratch instance, the file names it writes, and the link between the two sides (a drawn row lists the composed pictures it feeds, a composed row lists the makers it is made from). `findings` is empty when the two lists agree; a finding is a sentence for a person, and exit 1 comes with it. Checked by Tests/cli/contract.sh.

then.description: A picture this command draws: `feeds` names the composed pictures made from it.

else.description: A picture scripts/make-screenshots composes: `from` names the makers it is made from.

id.description: The maker to name on the command line: `risk snap <id> --out DIR`.

summary.description: One line about the picture. Display only: the text may be rewritten.

by.description: Who runs the maker: this command, or scripts/make-screenshots.

instance.description: True when making the picture starts a scratch riskell. False for a picture drawn from text alone.

files.description: The names that land in --out, in the order the app writes them. `<atom>` stands for the card's atom.

feeds.description: A drawn row: the ids of the composed pictures made from these files.

from.description: A composed row: the ids of the makers its files come from; empty when the script draws it from text.

findings.description: Where this table and scripts/make-screenshots disagree. Empty when they agree, and then the run exits 0.
